chunks: Eight pairs, two of the sheep and two of the goats. Say: Did He forbid the two males or the two females, or what the females carry in their wombs? Inform me with knowledge, if you are truthful.
ai.seo_question: What were the specific animal prohibitions of the pre-Islamic Arabs mentioned in Surah Al-An'am?
ai.summary: This verse critiques the specific animal sacrifices of the pre-Islamic Meccan polytheists, who arbitrarily forbade certain male and female livestock and their offspring without divine basis. Shia scholars highlight this as a demonstration of the Qur'an's refutation of baseless religious innovations (bid'ah) and the need for evidentiary proof in matters of worship. The rhetorical challenge 'if you are truthful' underscores the lack of scriptural authority behind their customs.
